name: KYC Verification Limit
description: Minimum documents and verification steps required for customer KYC on transactions under Rs. 10,000, including Aadhaar-based e-KYC and video KYC procedures.

name: UPI Transaction Cap
description: Maximum per-transaction and daily cumulative limits for UPI payments processed through the platform for retail customers.

name: Loan Interest Rate Disclosure
description: Requirements for disclosing annual percentage rate (APR), processing fees, and penal charges to borrowers before loan disbursement.

name: Data Localization for Payment Data
description: Requirement to store all payment transaction data exclusively on servers located within India.

name: Grievance Redressal Timeline
description: Maximum time allowed to acknowledge and resolve customer complaints related to failed transactions or unauthorized debits.

name: Merchant Onboarding Due Diligence
description: Minimum verification checks (business registration, PAN, bank account validation) required before onboarding a new merchant.

name: Two-Factor Authentication for High-Value Transfers
description: Mandatory additional authentication factor for fund transfers above a specified threshold amount.

name: Recurring Payment (Auto-Debit) Mandate Rules
description: Pre-debit notification requirements and customer consent rules for recurring auto-debit mandates on subscriptions and EMIs.

name: Chargeback and Refund Processing Time
description: Maximum number of business days allowed to process a customer refund or chargeback after a failed or disputed transaction.

name: Credit Bureau Reporting Frequency
description: Frequency and format requirements for reporting customer loan repayment data to credit information companies.

name: Third-Party Data Sharing Consent
description: Explicit customer consent requirements before sharing transaction or financial data with third-party partners or aggregators.

name: Suspicious Transaction Reporting (STR)
description: Internal thresholds and timelines for flagging and reporting suspicious transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit.

name: Card Tokenization Requirement
description: Requirement to tokenize stored card credentials instead of storing raw card numbers, per card network guidelines.

name: Payroll Payment Cutoff Timelines
description: Deadlines for initiating payroll bank transfers relative to the stated salary disbursement date.

name: Interest-Free Period on Credit Products
description: Rules governing the minimum interest-free repayment period offered on credit line and BNPL products.
